# Maintenance policy

**Estimates under assumptions, on simulated data.** Costs are assumptions (`business` in `configs/config.yaml`:
in-service failure 1000, planned visit 200, 1 per cycle of
life given up), NASA C-MAPSS is a simulation, and no real fleet cost data exist here. Design: D-024, D-025.

**Rule:** book a shop visit when the calibrated P(fail within 30 cycles) reaches
**0.0094**; the visit happens 30 cycles later (lead time). Champion model version
1 (gold Delta version 24, feature spec `1035ca0e0605`). The
threshold is stored in `artifacts/policy.json` and as tag `policy_threshold` on the model version.

## 1. Policies compared (709 training engines, full lives)

Every training engine runs to failure, so each policy's outcome is known. The decision signal is the out-of-fold
probability (no engine is scored by a model that saw it). The model threshold and the fixed intervals (per
dataset) are chosen on four folds and applied to the fifth (cross-fitted), so the costs below are not inflated by
choosing and scoring on the same engines.

## 3. Holdout check on the official test engines

The served rule applied to the 707 test engines with the champion's probabilities. Test engines stop before
failure, so an outcome is known only if the rule fires inside the observed window, or if the engine is already
within the lead time of failure at its last observed cycle without an alert (a certain failure). The rest are
censored.

| status                |   engines |   mean_rul_at_decision |   mean_lost |
|:----------------------|----------:|-----------------------:|------------:|
| decided: in time      |       246 |                 66.045 |      36.045 |
| decided: too late     |         3 |                 29.667 |     nan     |
| not decided: censored |       458 |                nan     |     nan     |
